{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Define complete cases: baseline ≠ -999.0 and final ≠ -999.0
complete_cases = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0)]

# Compute change in biomarker: final - baseline
complete_cases['change'] = complete_cases['biomarker_final'] - complete_cases['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change by sex across all patients in the complete cases (both arms)
mean_change_by_sex = complete_cases.groupby('sex')['change'].mean()

# Compute difference in mean change between females and males (female - male)
mean_change_female = mean_change_by_sex['F']
mean_change_male = mean_change_by_sex['M']
difference = mean_change_female - mean_change_male

# Output
mean_change_female, mean_change_male, difference"}
